integrity: General homotopy argument, explicit finite verifier and saved output included. Finite modular computations are corroboration, not a substitute for the infinite-family proof.
scientific_limitations: Finite connected simple graphs only; girth at least five and minimum degree at least three.
No assertion for closed-neighborhood Čech complexes or graphs with shorter cycles or degree below three.
The graph-level wedge equivalence is not asserted to be equivariant; only canonical higher integral homology orientation modules are identified.
Publication priority relative to unindexed equivalent literature is not certified; independent mathematical audit not performed.
title: Open-neighborhood homotopy of line graphs without short cycles
